{{Quote|Plus, the Starbreeze is a mu-type shuttle. Slip of a thing; haven't been able to locate her in the wreckage. Our only lead is inside the Imperial Army.|Ardun Kothe|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Starbreeze.png|thumb|right|150px|The ''Starbreeze'']]
The '''''mu''-type shuttle''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] model that was in use during the [[Great Galactic War]]. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Laren Omas]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] owned a ''mu''-type named the ''[[Starbreeze]]'', and it was among the [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] after the [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|Battle of Hoth]].

==Behind the scenes==
Ardun Kothe describes the ''Starbreeze'' as a ''mu''-type shuttle, but the ''Starbreeze'' actually makes use of the [[Imperial military transport]] ship model, which is an Imperial vessel and not a shuttle.
